heading: Accounts
first: Start STFC through Daystrom to add the first account.
newQuestion: Start STFC without an existing Daystrom profile to add a new account?
newInstructions: Sign in to the intended Scopely account. Daystrom will detect and add its player profile automatically.
removeDescription: Delete this account's local profile and login data from this device.
closeGameToRemove: Close STFC before deleting local account data.
deleteLocalOnly: Daystrom only deletes the local profile and login data for {{name}} on this device.
deleteScopely: This does not delete the account from Scopely. Contact Scopely Support to delete the account itself.
deleteUnlinkedWarning: If this account is not linked to a Scopely ID, you may permanently lose access to it after deleting the local data.
